format.scope: Offline static foot navigation; not an engine path, dynamic collision proof or farm-cycle ETA.
format.blobs: zlib/base64; bytes and SHA256 refer to uncompressed payloads
format.gnv: Original VPK member incl. header; ascending Y rows; (flags & 1) && !(flags & 6)
format.trm: Original v1 tree table incl. layer names, duplicate retained; records are LE int32 X,Y,layer (NOT tree Z)
format.entityTreeZQ4: TRM order, int16LE / 4, -32768 if not matched to a compiled tree entity
format.solidSurfaceQ4: GNV order, highest default PHYS surface at each cell center, int16LE / 4, -32768 if no hit
format.clipMask: GNV order, byte bit0=projected npcclip/playerclip geometry, bit1=raised reserve
format.speed: Required actual/estimated effective XY units/s for the whole leg; heroBase is NOT a substitute.
